mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.plan_version_id, o.amount_cents, o.currency, o.billing_mode, o.status, o.external_txn_id, o.paid_at, o.source_drama_id, o.refunded_at, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM orders o JOIN ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) AS rn FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND refunded_at IS NULL ) r ON r.id = o.id WHERE r.rn = 1 AND o.paid_at >= #{start} AND o.paid_at < #{end} AND o.source_drama_id IN (SELECT id FROM dramas WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId}) ORDER BY o.paid_at ASC, o.id ASC
